### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/BigBirdReturns/clifford-number/blob/f652bc75a561809550055f0092f1132f4644360f/tools/lib/hops.mjs#L90-L91 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Suppress stale rejections once another stint overlaps** When the same two actors have multiple stints on a surface, this loop now correctly skips self-pairs but still appends a `rejected_hop_pairs` entry for every non-overlapping stint combination before considering whether another combination for the same actor pair does overlap. For example, A in 2020 and 2022, B in 2021 and 2022 produces both a valid 2022 hop and three “no connection asserted” rejections for the same surface/pair, so the UI’s standing refusals can contradict the actual hop graph. Rejections should be emitted per actor pair/surface only after all stint combinations are known to have no overlap.
